reason: Method relies on 60-minute candle confirmations of pivots against supply/demand zones inside the trading day and does not survive daily-bar approximation.

universe.description: high beta US stocks including FANG names and volatile names with wide intraday ranges

setup.rule: Identify pivot as directional area on 60-min chart that can shift direction
setup.quote: a pivot first of all is a directional an area of a chart okay an area of a chart uh that potentially can shift in Direction

setup.rule: Pivot must hit supply or demand zone (moving averages, Bollinger bands, linear regression) and next 60-min candle confirms
setup.quote: if a stock is a potential pivot and it hits a supply or demand Zone okay ... and the next candle confirms that Supply or Demand on a 60-minute view

entry.rule: Go long when stock violates top of range and builds above pivot on 60-min confirmation
entry.quote: when the stock violates the top of the range and builds upon that level I go long

entry.rule: Go short when stock breaks below range and builds below pivot on 60-min confirmation
entry.quote: when the stock breaks below that range and and and starts building below that pivot I go short

sizing.rule: Risk maximum 1% of account per trade with fixed dollar risk to determine share size for biggest upside within that risk
sizing.quote: the maximum Max maximum F fixed risk on every single trade should be 1% right 1% that should be your maximum risk

market_filter.rule: Compare stock action in last 60-min interval to futures direction; avoid trades where stock moves against futures
market_filter.quote: what has the stock done in relation to the Futures ... if the Futures are exploding and these stocks are taking out lows there's something wrong

ambiguities.issue: Exact stop, target and exit rules not specified beyond room to next supply/demand zone
